description: 克隆 MiniOneRec 仓库并在 CPU 计算上把 OpenJev 快照下载到共享 datastore

commands.name: 克隆 MiniOneRec 仓库到工作目录
commands.description: 在当前工作目录(writable wd)克隆仓库，避免依赖 /home/aiscuser (CPU 节点可能不存在)
commands.command: REPO=./MiniOneRec; rm -rf $REPO && git clone https://github.com/overwindows/MiniOneRec.git $REPO && cd $REPO && git checkout dev && echo 'CLONE_OK pwd='$(pwd)

commands.name: 检查挂载布局与可写性
commands.description: 列出 datastore 挂载根目录与目标路径，并用真实写文件探测可写性（cosmos was read-only; adls should be writable）
commands.command: REPO=./MiniOneRec; cd $REPO && DEST={mount_dir}/{dest_path} && echo '=== mount_dir:' {mount_dir} '===' && echo '--- dest parent ---' && ls -la $(dirname $DEST) | head -20 && echo '--- write probe on dest parent (real file) ---' && (echo x > $(dirname $DEST)/__wtest && echo 'WRITE_DESTPARENT_OK' && rm -f $(dirname $DEST)/__wtest || echo 'WRITE_DESTPARENT_FAIL') && echo 'PROBE_DONE'

commands.name: 下载 OpenJev 快照
commands.description: 使用 huggingface_hub snapshot_download 把模型预置到共享 datastore，避免占用 A100 GPU 时长
commands.command: REPO=./MiniOneRec; cd $REPO && DEST={mount_dir}/{dest_path} && mkdir -p $(dirname $DEST) && echo '=== downloading {repo_id} ->' $DEST '===' && python src/download_hf_model.py --repo_id {repo_id} --dest $DEST && du -sh $DEST && ls -la $DEST | head -20 && echo 'DOWNLOAD_COMPLETE'

commands.name: 调试模式-保持容器运行
commands.command: echo '=== 调试模式: 容器将保持运行 ===' && sleep infinity
